search.desc: Kwala kgotsa bua lefoko mme o bone bokao jotlhe jwa lone, mekai, setshwantsho le tshimologo ya lone.
search.s1: Kwala lefoko mo lebokosong la patlo, kgotsa tobetsa maekerofouno mme o le bue.
search.s3: Tobetsa 'Setshwantsho' ka fa tlase ga bokao gore o bone setshwantsho sa jone.
search.s4: Kwa bofelong: gore lefoko le tswa kae, morago ga moo konopo ya 'Gad it!'.
listen.s1: Fa thoko ga lefoko, tobetsa aekhone ya sebuisa-modumo.
save.title: Bukana ya gago e a itlatsa
save.desc: Lefoko lengwe le lengwe le o le batlang le bolokwa mo bukaneng ya gago ka go iketsa.
save.s1: Lefoko lengwe le lengwe le o le batlang le a ipoloka, ga go na sepe sa go tobetsa.
save.s2: Go bona mafoko a gago, bula 'Bukana' mo menung e e kwa godimo.
save.s3: Mafoko otlhe a gago a koo, mme mo maanong a a duelwang a dira le fa o se mo inthaneteng.
save.s4: Mo Basic, bukana ya mahala e boloka mafoko a fitlha go a le 30.
context.title: Bokao jo bo nepagetseng jwa polelo ya gago
context.desc: Tsenya polelo e lefoko le tlhagang mo go yone mme o bone bokao bo le bongwe jo bo tshwanang.
context.s1: Kwala lefoko, mme mo lefelong le le ka fa tlase ga lone, kwala polelo e le tlhagang mo go yone.
context.s2: Gadit e go naya bokao bo le bongwe jo bo tshwanang le polelo eo.
context.s3: Lefelo leo leo le ka fa tlase ga bara ya patlo mo tsebeng nngwe le nngwe ya lefoko.
wordpage.title: Tse dingwe ka lefoko lengwe le lengwe
wordpage.desc: Kwala polelo ya gago, bona mekai e mengwe mme o tshwaye lefoko gore o le tlhalogantse.
wordpage.s1: Ka fa tlase ga bokao, tobetsa 'Kwala polelo ya gago mme o tlhome gore o tlhalogantse'.
wordpage.s2: Kwala kgotsa bua polelo ya gago, tobetsa 'Tlhola polelo' mme o bone karabo gone foo.
wordpage.s3: Mo maanong a a duelwang, '+ Dipolelo tse dingwe tsa sekai' e tsenya mekai e meraro e mesha.
wordpage.s4: Kwa bofelong, tobetsa 'Gad it!' mme lefoko le tla tshwaiwa gore o a le tlhaloganya mo bukaneng ya gago.
extras.title: Dipotso ka lefoko
extras.desc: Mo maanong a a duelwang: dikganetso, mafoko a a tshwanang, lelapa la mafoko, diphoso tse di tlwaelegileng le gore o ka le gakologelwa jang.
extras.s1: Morago ga 'Gad it!', 'O na le potso ka lefoko leno?' e neela dipotso di le tlhano.
extras.s2: Tobetsa potso mme karabo e bulege ka fa tlase fela.
kids.title: Kids Mode
kids.desc: Switch e le nngwe mo bareng e e kwa godimo e tlhalosa lefoko lengwe le lengwe ka tsela e o ka e tlhalosetsang ngwana.
kids.s1: Mo Family, bula switch ya 'Bana' fa thoko ga logo.
kids.s2: Jaanong tlhaloso nngwe le nngwe e kwaletswe ngwana.
kids.s3: Fa e buletswe, menu e bontsha 'Tiro ya sekolo' go na le 'Ikwetlise'.
kids.s4: Mo sedirisweng se se abelanwang, bula 'Shared kids screen' mo My family, mme ngwana mongwe le mongwe a tobetse setshwantsho sa gagwe.
install.desc: Tsenya Gadit mo sekirining sa gago sa gae mo iPhone, kgotsa o e tsenye mo Android.
install.s1: Mo iPhone, bula gadit.app mo Safari mme o tobetsa konopo ya Abelana.
install.s2: Ya kwa tlase, tlhopha 'Tsenya mo sekirining sa gae' mme o tobetse 'Tsenya'.
install.s3: Mo Android, tsenya app ya Gadit go tswa mo Google Play, kgotsa tobetsa 'Tsenya' mo Chrome.
install.s4: Jaanong Gadit e bulega go tswa mo aekhoneng ya yone, jaaka app nngwe le nngwe.
addchild.title: Tsenya leloko la lelapa
addchild.desc: Tlhopha karolo, leina le mmala, ka bana ba fitlha go ba le 5 mo Family.
addchild.s1: Mo My family, mo tabeng ya Family, tobetsa 'Tsenya leloko la lelapa'.
addchild.s2: Tlhopha karolo: Rre, Mme, Morwa kgotsa Morwadi.
addchild.s3: Kwala leina, tlhopha mmala, tsenya dingwaga fa o batla, mme o tobetsa 'Tsenya mo lelapeng'.
addchild.s4: Fa leina le setse le le mo lelapeng, o ka golaganya porofaele eo gape mme wa boloka mafoko a yone.
pair.desc: Golaganya sedirisiwa sa ngwana ka khoutu ya QR kgotsa khoutu ya dinomore di le 6.
pair.s1: Mo tabeng ya Family, tobetsa 'Golaganya sedirisiwa' mo karateng ya ngwana.
pair.s2: Sekenela khoutu ya QR ka sedirisiwa sa ngwana, kgotsa bula gadit.app/join koo mme o kwale khoutu.
pair.s3: Mo iPhone, bula Gadit go tswa mo aekhoneng ya yone ya sekirini sa gae mme o tobetsa 'Tsenya khoutu'.
pair.s4: Kwala dinomore tsotlhe di le 6, mme ngwana yo o golagantsweng gape o boelwa ke mafoko otlhe a gagwe.
dash.s1: Bula 'My family' go tswa mo menung ya avatar, mme tab ya Gae e sobokanya tsotlhe tsa lelapa.
dash.s2: Ngwana mongwe le mongwe o na le karata e e nang le mafoko, malatsi a a latelanang, maemo le mafoko a bosheng.
dash.s3: Maemo a lelapa a bontsha gore mongwe le mongwe wa lona o batlile mafoko a le kae.
dash.s4: 'Dipatlisiso tsa bosheng' di thathamisa lefoko lengwe le lengwe le bana ba le batlileng, la bosheng pele.
alerts.title: Dikitsiso ka bana ba gago
alerts.desc: Utlwa ka mafoko, dikwalelo, dithuto, metshameko, go bala le dintwa.
alerts.s1: Mo My family, mo Dithulaganyong, bulela 'Mpolelele se bana ba me ba se dirang mo Gadit'.
alerts.s2: Tlhopha 'Sengwe le sengwe, gone jaanong' kgotsa 'Kakaretso ya letsatsi le letsatsi'.
alerts.s3: Tlhopha se o batlang go se utlwelwa, mme o bulele dikitsiso gangwe mo sedirisweng sengwe le sengwe.
alerts.s4: Dikitsiso di tla ka imeile, le jaaka banner ya founo kwa go kgonegang.
homework.title: Tiro ya sekolo
homework.desc: Bakeng sa bana mo Family: tsenya tiro ya sekolo ka setshwantsho kgotsa mamaretsha, morago o e ikwetlisetse.
homework.s1: Mo 'Tiro ya sekolo', tobetsa Tsaya setshwantsho, Romela kgotsa Mamaretsha go tsenya tiro ya sekolo ya bosigo jono.
homework.s2: Tlhola mafoko, tlhopha gore ke eng le gore teko e leng leng, morago o tobetsa Boloka.
homework.s3: Tiro ya sekolo e emetse ka fa tlase ga 'Tse di tshwanetseng go dirwa', gaufi le go ithuta mafoko, go bala le go ipaakanyetsa teko.
homework.s4: 'Go ithuta mafoko' go na le kwalelo, reetsa o bo o tlhopha, motshameko wa ditshwantsho le dithuto tsa puo.
ranks.title: Maemo, malatsi a a latelanang le maemo a lelapa
ranks.desc: Lefoko lengwe le lengwe le lesha le go atametsa kwa maemong a a latelang, mme boikwetliso jo bo fetsweng bo bula di-skin tse dintšha.
ranks.s1: Tobetsa badge ya maemo mo bareng e e kwa godimo go bona maemo a gago.
ranks.s2: Lefoko lengwe le lengwe le lesha mo bukeng ya gago le go tlhatlosetsa mo maemong.
ranks.s3: Bana ba bona malatsi a a latelanang, maikaelelo a beke le maemo a bone, mme maemo a a kwa godimo a bula ponalo e mesha.
ranks.s4: Maemo a lelapa mo My family a bontsha gore ke mang yo o batlileng mafoko a mantsi go gaisa.
reader.desc: Tsaya setshwantsho, mamaretsha kgotsa romela temana, tobetsa lefoko lengwe le lengwe, morago o tlhome gore o tlhalogantse.
reader.s1: Mo 'Lefoko lengwe le lengwe', mamaretsha temana, tsaya setshwantsho sa tsebe, romela setshwantsho kgotsa PDF, kgotsa abelana sekirini sa gago.
reader.s2: 'Mafoko a botlhokwa mo temaneng eno' a bontsha mafoko a a tshwanetseng go ithutiwa pele.
reader.s3: Tobetsa lefoko lengwe le lengwe go bona bokao jwa lone, mme lefoko lengwe le lengwe le o le bulang le fetoga tala.
reader.s4: Kwa bofelong, tlhatlhobo ya go bala e botsa gore mafoko a raya eng mo temaneng.
say.title: Le bue ka puo e nngwe
say.desc: Kwala polelo, tlhopha puo, e utlwe mme o ikwetlisetse go e bua.
say.s1: Mo 'Le bue', kwala kgotsa rekota polelo mme o tlhophe puo e o batlang go e utlwa ka yone.
say.s2: Tobetsa 'Le bue' mme o utlwe sentle gore e utlwala jang.
say.s3: Morago tobetsa 'Ikwetlisetse go e bua' mme o e bue kwa godimo.
say.s4: O bona dinaledi di fitlha go tse tlhano, le kgakololo fa e ise e nne teng sentle.
practice.title: Ikwetlise
practice.desc: Bakeng sa bagolo mo Individual le Family: go bala, go ipaakanyetsa teko, kwalelo le puo.
practice.s1: Bula 'Ikwetlise' mo menung e e kwa godimo.
practice.s2: Tlhopha sengwe mo go tse nne: go bala, teko, kwalelo kgotsa puo.
practice.s3: Bakeng sa teko, mamaretsha lenane la mafoko mme o ikwetlise go fitlha letsatsing leo.
practice.s4: Mo kwalelong o utlwa lefoko, o a le kwala mme o bone mopeletto o o siameng.
games.title: Metshameko ya mafoko
games.desc: Metshameko ka mafoko a a mo bukaneng ya gago, le tse dingwe tse dintsi.
games.s1: Bula 'Tshameka' mo menung e e kwa godimo.
games.s2: 'Go tswa mo bukaneng ya gago' go tshameka ka mafoko a o a batlileng.
games.s3: Ka fa tlase go na le metshameko e mengwe ka ditshimologo tsa mafoko, mafoko a a nepileng le popego ya mafoko.
games.s4: Motshameko mongwe le mongwe o o fetsweng o go atametsa skin e ntšha.
duel.title: Ntwa ya Mafoko
duel.desc: Dipotso tse di tshwanang kgatlhanong le lelapa, tsala kgotsa Word Bot.
duel.s2: Tshameka mo sedirisweng seno, laletsa ka khoutu kgotsa linki, tsena ka khoutu, kgotsa tshameka le Word Bot.
duel.s3: Go tshameka le mongwe yo o mo inthaneteng jaanong, motsadi o bulela 'Ntwa ya Mafoko le bana ba bangwe' mo Dithulaganyong.
duel.s4: Yo o nepagetseng ka bonako o a fenya, mme tafole ya diphenyo e boloka maduo.
account.s1: Bula 'Akhaonto' go tswa mo menung ya avatar go bona leano la gago.
account.s2: Mo Basic, tobetsa 'Tlhatlosetsa go Family' kgotsa 'Tlhatlosetsa go Individual'.
account.s4: Mo leanong le le duelwang, 'Laola ditefelo' le 'Fetola leano' di tlhokomela tsotlhe tse dingwe.
cancel.title: Khansela, emisa kgotsa tima ntšhafatso
cancel.desc: Se se diregang fa o khansela, le ditsela tse di bonolo mo tseleng.
cancel.s1: Mo Akhaontong, tobetsa 'Khansela peeletso' mme o tlhophe lebaka fa o batla.
cancel.s2: Mo leanong la kgwedi le kgwedi, o ka emisa ka kgwedi e le nngwe go na le moo, o sa duele.
cancel.s3: Mo tekong ya mahala, lebaka la 'Ke ne ke sa batle go duedisiwa ka go iketsa' le go letla go tima ntšhafatso fela.
cancel.s4: Fa o fetola mogopolo, tobetsa 'Ke khanseditse ka phoso, tlogela peeletso e ntse'.
